title: Copying the Remaining Suffix
statement: Let $x$ and $r$ be Boolean words. For every pair of words $p,o$ such that $x=p\mathbin{++}r$, the suffix-extraction machine, started in state $5$ at the clamped input offset $|p|$, with a unary counter of length $n$ and its head at $n$, and with output $o$, reaches after $|r|+1$ steps the halting configuration at the clamped offset $|x|$, with the same counter and head and output $o\mathbin{++}r$.
replaced:
Let the native input decompose as $x = p \mathbin{+\!\!+} r$ with the suffix
extractor in its copy state at clamped offset $|p|$. Then exactly $|r| + 1$ steps
emit every bit of $r$ and halt on the right blank, with the counter untouched.
